titus.3.p1.b1.text: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient

titus.3.p1.b2.text: and ready for every good work,

titus.3.p1.b3.text: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.

titus.3.p1.b4.text: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, … being hated and hating one another.

titus.3.p2.b1.text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,

titus.3.p2.b2.text: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.

titus.3.p2.b3.text: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior, … we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.

titus.3.p2.b4.text: This saying is trustworthy. … These things are excellent and profitable for the people.

titus.3.p3.b1.text: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, … because these things are pointless and worthless.

titus.3.p3.b2.text: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,

titus.3.p3.b3.text: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.

titus.3.p4.b1.text: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you,

titus.3.p4.b2.text: make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

titus.3.p4.b3.text: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need. … so that they will not be unfruitful.

titus.3.p4.b4.text: All who are with me send you greetings. … Grace be with all of you.
